End of the Year Surrender & Reset  
Women’s Retreat  
December 4 - 6, 2026  
Golden Hill Retreat Center • Coldspring, Texas  
  
A weekend to soften, release, restore, and make space for what comes next.  
  
Before stepping into another year with new goals, plans, and expectations, give yourself permission to pause. [...] A Different Kind of Year-End Reset  
  
At the end of the year, there can be so much pressure to evaluate what we accomplished and immediately start planning how we will improve ourselves next year.  
  
This retreat offers another way:  
Before setting new goals, we listen  
Before adding more, we release.  
Before asking what comes next, we honor where we are.  
  
You are allowed to end the year softly, surrender what was, rest in what is, create space for what wants to emerge. [...] The End of the Year Surrender & Reset Women’s Retreat is a restorative weekend created to help you step away from everyday responsibilities, reconnect with yourself, and intentionally close the year with greater peace and clarity.  
  
Surrounded by the peaceful setting of Golden Hill Retreat Center, we will slow down through gentle yoga, somatic movement, breathwork, meditation, journaling, sound healing, meaningful connection, and plenty of space to simply rest.
